name: Grinning Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A fat pumpkin with a lopsided grin and a candle glowing behind its eyes, set out to keep the dark honest.

era.note: Plain carved pumpkin with a candle glow; folk custom, no creature or expansion tie. Art (0x4691, glowing animated frame) is a later client addition.

name: Toothy Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A squat, round-bellied lantern grinning through two rows of square teeth.

era.note: A carved pumpkin lantern is plain folk custom, tied to no creature, race or expansion; the Hallows-tide candle-in-a-gourd reads as ordinary Britannian dressing. Art is a later client addition.

name: Broad-Grin Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A lantern with a mouth as wide as a harvest moon and not a care in the world.

era.note: A carved pumpkin lantern is plain folk custom, tied to no creature, race or expansion; the Hallows-tide candle-in-a-gourd reads as ordinary Britannian dressing. Art is a later client addition.

name: Mournful Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: Droopy eyes and a drooping mouth: the saddest pumpkin in all Britannia, glowing sadly through the night.

era.note: A carved pumpkin lantern is plain folk custom, tied to no creature, race or expansion; the Hallows-tide candle-in-a-gourd reads as ordinary Britannian dressing. Art is a later client addition.

name: Owl Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A pumpkin carved with a wide-eyed owl perched in a window of candlelight.

era.note: Pumpkin carved with an owl silhouette; owls are ordinary woodland fowl. Generic seasonal decor; art 0x9F24 is a later client addition.

name: Black Cat Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A cat's pointed ears and whiskers cut into a pumpkin, glowing like a hearth-side tabby.

era.note: Pumpkin carved with a cat's face; house cats are everyday folk. Generic seasonal decor, art 0x9F28 is a later client addition.

name: Welcome Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: The word WELCOME carved in flickering letters: a friendly lantern for a doorstep, or a trap.

era.note: Pumpkin carved with the word Welcome; a doorstep custom with no expansion tie. Art 0xA5E5 is a later client addition.

name: Skull Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A real skull seems to grin out of a split pumpkin, red-eyed and fire-lit.

era.note: Skulls and bone ornaments read as ordinary dark-magic dressing in 2000 Britannia; the pumpkin is plain harvest folk custom. Art 0xA166 is a later client addition.

name: Tongue-Out Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A squinting pumpkin sticks out a long orange tongue at every passer-by.

era.note: Whimsical carved pumpkin with no creature, race or expansion tie. Art 0xA16A is a later client addition.

name: Two-Faced Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: Half the pumpkin smiles, half is sour and rotten: you never quite know which face to trust.

era.note: Pumpkin carved with two faces, a generic folk motif tied to no creature or expansion. Art 0xA16E is a later client addition.

name: Kraken Jack-o'-Lantern
blurb: A pumpkin carved with a curling many-armed beast of the deep, its tentacles aglow.

era.note: Pumpkin carved with a sea-monster's tentacles; sea serpents and krakens are sailors' legends, not a specific later creature. Art 0xA397 is a later client addition.

name: Great Dragon Pumpkin
blurb: A prodigious pumpkin, carved from stem to base with a coiling wyrm breathing fire across its hide.

era.note: A huge carved pumpkin showing a dragon; dragons existed by 2000 and the pumpkin is plain folk custom. Art 0xA199 (lit, animated) is a later client addition.

name: Witch-Carved Tall Pumpkin
blurb: A tall oval pumpkin with a witch on her broomstick cut in silhouette against the candle glow.

era.note: A witch-on-broom silhouette is folk Hallows-tide dressing, not a specific later class or skill. Art 0x9931 is a later client addition.

name: Carved Pumpkin Trio
blurb: Three tall pumpkins in a huddle: one with a skull, one with a bat and one with a spider, all burning orange.

era.note: Three carved tall pumpkins (skull, bat, spider): ordinary dark-magic dressing with no creature or expansion tie. Art is a later client addition.

name: White Pumpkin with Black Cat
blurb: A pale ghost-white pumpkin with a black cat curled on its glowing side.

era.note: White pumpkin carved with a curled cat; plain folk dressing, no expansion tie. Art 0xB261 is a later client addition.

name: White Pumpkin with Ghost
blurb: A pale gourd with a little white spirit carved into its flank, floating in candlelight.

era.note: White pumpkin carved with a plain sheeted ghost; ghosts are ordinary folk-tale fare. Art 0xB4FD is a later client addition.

name: Pumpkin Stack
blurb: Two pumpkins stacked fat-over-slim, topped with a stalk, like a squat orange snowman.

era.note: A balanced stack of plain pumpkins; harvest dressing with no expansion tie. Art 0x6407 is a later client addition.

name: Pumpkin Farmer
blurb: A scarecrow built of two pumpkins, a carved grin, a battered hat and a pitchfork propped at his side.

era.note: A pumpkin-bodied scarecrow with hat and pitchfork; scarecrows and gourd men are field folklore. Art 0x640A/0x640B is a later client addition.

name: Jumbo Pumpkin

era.note: A giant prize pumpkin: plain harvest decor with no expansion tie, assembled from three tile slices. Art 0x9D2B-0x9D2D is a later client addition.

name: Fanged Pumpkin Vine

era.note: A fanged pumpkin on a vine, a whimsical garden-gone-wrong motif with no creature or expansion tie. Art 0xA9BE is a later client addition.

name: Pumpkin Candy Bowl

era.note: A pumpkin-shaped bowl of sweets; generic seasonal tableware. Art 0x6401 is a later client addition.

era.note: A plain iron cauldron; cooking and brewing pots are everyday kit. Generic Halloween dressing; art 0xA5B4 is a later client addition.

name: Haunted Scarecrow

era.note: A ragged pumpkin-headed scarecrow; scarecrows are ordinary field fixtures. Art 0x469B is a later client addition.

era.note: A burning scarecrow, a harvest-bonfire custom with no expansion tie. Art 0x9F3A/0x9F34 (animated flame frames) is a later client addition.

name: Ghost Yard Ornament

name: Pumpkin-Headed Figurehead

name: Snowman
